relations.subject: Geshe Rabten
relations.evidence: He was a student at Sera Monastery in Lhasa, and achieved Geshe status before leaving Tibet in 1959.

relations.subject: Lama Yeshe
relations.evidence: Lama Yeshe and Lama Zopa Rinpoche were guided by him in their early days outside of Tibet.

relations.subject: Geshe Rabten
relations.evidence: In the mid 1960s Geshe Rabten was a religious assistant to the Dalai Lama.

relations.subject: Geshe Rabten
relations.evidence: He was the founder of the Rabten Choeling Centre (which was originally named Tharpa Choeling) in Switzerland in 1979.

relations.evidence: Other centres that he founded in Europe included the Tibetan centre in Hamburg, Tashi Rabten at the Letzehof, Puntsog Rabten in Munich and Gephel Ling in Milan.
